Before submitting, please:

- search existing issues to avoid duplicates
- check the vignette and the package documentation
- choose a short plain-text title naming the function or area and the problem, e.g., "getData(): error for sites without climate data"
- for wrong or missing values in the database, use the "Database content problem" template instead
- read [Asking for help and reporting issues](https://github.com/TheoreticalEcology/ProfoundData/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#asking-for-help-and-reporting-issues) in the contributing guide
-->
